items.title: Marvin Harrison: Gets first TD with Texans
items.text:
Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Two TD passes in OT loss
items.text:
Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Woody Marks: Racks up 20 touches in Week 7
items.text:
Marks rushed 19 times for 66 yards and caught his only target for 15 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Nico Collins: Limited to six yards in OT loss
items.text:
Collins caught two of five targets for six yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Shut down by Minnesota
items.text:
Jones completed 13 of 22 passes for 108 yards with an interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings. He added 13 yards on four carries.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Pair of rush TDs in win
items.text:
Irving rushed 24 times for 106 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in one of two targets for four yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Suffers hamstring injury
items.text:
Skattebo told Dan Graziano of ESPN after Sunday's 27-21 overtime win at Houston that he "felt something in his hamstring" during his final carry of the game.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Carries offense in Week 7 loss
items.text:
Taylor carried the ball 18 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught two of three targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Vikings.
